race.comment: Looks a wide-open contest. STEIN (11) grows a leg for hoop Fenlon who has a win and two placings from just three steers and will be rock-hard fit for this fourth-up from the spell. Looks well placed against this line-up. STRADA VARENNA (1) is having the first run for the Gollan yard but brings solid Sydney formlines to the table and gets some weight relief with the 3kg claim. In the mix. VANESSI (4) has placed two of four over this distance range and is drawn to get a cosy run in transit from the inside alley. Can run a race while fresh. DON'T DOUBT MISSY (6) returns from a lay-off. Ran fourth in most recent trial at Doomben. Opened last campaign with a fourth at this track over 1110m. Keep safe fresh. SHE OURS (3) doesn't win out of turn but is usually thereabouts and may earn some minor money.
